scope: Isolated backend checkpoint only. No shared source edits, readpool/context changes, detail DTO/action/editor/controller/URL/frontend implementation or generic lock changes. Root may integrate the reviewed write-only checkpoint before138 using serial overlap/compatibility checks;138measurement snapshot stays immutable.129 still waits138+140+serial host checkpoint.

source.dependencies: linked existing node_modules only; no install

tests.command: bun test --coverage tests/spec-answer-write.test.ts tests/repository.test.ts tests/spec-detail-actions.test.ts tests/spec-answer-evaluation.test.ts tests/test-diagnostics.test.ts
tests.coverageScope: Selected tests/imported files only, not overall repository coverage. Unrelated imported code and the frozen oracle are included in All files. No whole-repo80% claim from this selection.

checks.faultSync: Controlled promises/spies, no sleeps as race synchronization
checks.lockReleaseFailure: Actual shared storage rm fault after confirmed rename; committed result/warning returned without target reread
checks.finalTempGuard: PASS: exclusive inode identity, exact size/digest, bounded length+1 read, stable observation and last pre-rename stamp; replacement/mutation/postverify-change regressions pass.
checks.longTargetName: PASS:243-byte target basename and short fixed-prefix UUID temp.

semantics.options: expectedRevision undefined is optional omission; null/empty/nonstring/non64lowercasehex rejects before lock IO. Validated value is captured before awaits.
semantics.errors: SpecQuestionWriteError code not_found/conflict/validation; content conflicts reason revision/question/target_changed; lock ownership/IO failures remain ordinary Error.
semantics.duplicateAnswers: Blank pairs ignored per legacy; equal trimmed nonblank duplicates accepted; contradictory duplicates reject the entire write. Canonical order and repeated question occurrences retained.
semantics.result: committedRevision hashes exact serialized/written Buffer; returned clone has no inherited provenance; cleanupWarning is additive only after confirmed commit.
semantics.compatibility: Pinned bf542e1 serializer/question oracle validates current canonical metadata/body. Legacy formatting normalization and unknown-TOML-key omission remain unchanged.

limits: No filesystem compare-and-swap claim: noncooperating writers can race final observation and rename.
No byte-format/unknown-frontmatter roundtrip preservation guarantee beyond legacy serializer behavior.
No frontend action mapping/editor/dirty guard or post-save evaluator guarantee; those remain129.
No context IO/performance/browser claims. No full suite repeated for this isolated backend checkpoint.
